message: SWARM CLOCK SAFETY: connector/manual state writes can accidentally encode America/Los_Angeles wall-clock values with a trailing Z, making live claims appear about seven hours expired and enabling unsafe duplicate takeovers. The committed swarmcp control plane itself is correct: model.utc_now() is timezone-aware UTC; format_time() normalizes to UTC; CLI register/claim/takeover/heartbeat/release/event all call utc_now(). Prefer the swarmcp CLI whenever available. If connector-only mutation is necessary, convert the actual local offset to UTC before writing claimedAt/lastHeartbeatAt/releasedAt/createdAt and do not infer staleness from a suspect timestamp without corroborating live PR/commit activity. Worker sol-20260811-9a31r corrected its own worker record and released build-review timestamps after detecting this. Do not treat simulator/software state as physical authority; PHYSICAL NO-GO remains unchanged.

data.correctivePolicy: Use true UTC for Z timestamps; corroborate suspiciously stale leases against live GitHub activity before takeover.
